preprocessing: PIL RGB -> Resize((512,512)) bilinear -> ToTensor -> Normalize(ImageNet mean/std)
output: 5 logits, sigmoid per label, order [D, G, C, A, H]

label_config.D: per-eye DR label from that eye's diagnostic keywords (results/run007_dr_per_eye_label_mapping.md)

selection_rule: seed with the median VALIDATION selection mean AUC (5 labels, D scored on per-eye labels) among seeds [0, 1, 2]; test set not used for this choice
note: Edge INT8 calibration must use images from train.csv only; the old edge/artifacts/calib_manifest.csv has 55 images that are now in test.csv.
